notes: Synthetic edits of FinanceBench evidence excerpts (CC BY-NC 4.0). Arms B-D are benchmark fixtures, not company figures. Arm D also removes any total the target could be recovered from by one addition or subtraction.
eligibility: A FinanceBench question qualifies when (1) it asks for one reported figure (question_reasoning 'Information extraction', numeric reference answer of 60 characters or fewer), (2) the captured context contains that figure in the row and fiscal-year column the question asks for, and (3) the four arms can be built cleanly (leak check passes).
split_rule: The three pilot cases go to dev, plus the remaining eligible case with the smallest SHA-256 of its id. Every other eligible case is reserved.
